title: Narrative Writing
titleMy: ဇာတ်လမ်း စာပိုဒ်
description: Type a narrative paragraph with past tense verbs.

exercises.instruction: Last summer, my family visited a small town by the sea. We woke up early to watch the fishermen pull in their boats. I collected bright shells on the sand. It was the happiest day of my year.
